description: The CREO AMP Advanced Modular Platform by Globus Medical is a modular head system that utilizes various polyaxial screw head options to offer a wide arrange of fusion options for a wide range of spinal pathologies. The system is divided into the screw posts and screw head. The screw head are interchangeable with other modular systems including MIS, MCS and Fenestrated. The wide array of screw options available make it a versatile set for standard degenerative, MIS, trauma, and complex spinal deformity cases.
